item.IPA_transcription: Ọkpá nōo yéekwukwu ā ó kwokwúukwuń.
item.gloss: The stream which babbles does not reach the knees.

item.IPA_transcription: Ẹplá nó wāa āa, ó kaá ɡaáā caácíń.
item.gloss: When he came, he said that you (pl.) would not cut the grass.
The prisoners dived into the water.

item.IPA_transcription: Aɡba nāa ɡba āa wẹnẹ̄hi nẹ.
item.gloss: The vomit which you vomited was a big one.
